title: Accessible-Rehab: automated adjustment of virtual environment elements to the safe range of motion of each patient
description: Calibration method that individually maps the motor limitations of each patient as an irregular volume representing their safe range of motion, and automatically adjusts the elements of the virtual environment to that personalised space. This work was supported by the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities / Agencia Estatal de Investigación under grant PID2020-117361RB-C21 (project REHAB-IMMERSIVE), and carried out by the AIR Research Group of the Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha in collaboration with the Hospital Nacional de Parapléjicos (Toledo, Spain).
